class.name: XRSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for OpenXR: foveation, render scale, refresh rate, performance levels and hand tracking.

method.name: clear_interface_override
method.description: Drives the [OpenXRInterface] of [XRServer] again after [method set_interface_override]. Pushes the stored values to it.

method.name: get_available_display_refresh_rates
method.description: Returns the refresh rates the runtime offers, sorted from low to high. Empty before the interface is initialized or if the runtime does not report its rates ([code]XR_FB_display_refresh_rate[/code] missing). Fill a menu with it.

method.name: get_cpu_level
method.description: Returns the pending CPU performance level. See [member XRSettings.cpu_level].

method.name: get_deferred_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values that were applied but could not reach the OpenXR interface yet, because there is no interface or it is not initialized. They are pushed when [XRServer] adds the interface and again when its session begins. Without a headset or OpenXR runtime every value except [member XRSettings.hand_tracking_enabled] stays here.

method.name: get_display_refresh_rate
method.description: Returns the pending display refresh rate in Hz ([code]0[/code]: runtime default). See [member XRSettings.display_refresh_rate].

method.name: get_foveation_level
method.description: Returns the pending foveation level. See [member XRSettings.foveation_level].

method.name: get_gpu_level
method.description: Returns the pending GPU performance level. See [member XRSettings.gpu_level].

method.name: get_interface
method.description: Returns the object the domain drives: the interface set with [method set_interface_override], else the [OpenXRInterface] of [XRServer] (the interface named [method get_interface_name]), or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_interface_name
method.description: Returns the name of the [XRServer] interface the domain drives: [code]"OpenXR"[/code].

method.name: get_left_hand_motion_range
method.description: Returns the pending motion range of the left hand. See [member XRSettings.left_hand_motion_range].

method.name: get_render_target_size_multiplier
method.description: Returns the pending render scale. See [member XRSettings.render_target_size_multiplier].

method.name: get_right_hand_motion_range
method.description: Returns the pending motion range of the right hand. See [member XRSettings.right_hand_motion_range].

method.name: get_unsupported_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values the current OpenXR runtime does not support, for example [code]foveation_level[/code] on SteamVR. They are stored and saved, but not pushed; hide or disable them in the options menu. Empty before the interface is initialized: support is not known yet (see [method is_interface_ready]). See [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: get_vrs_min_radius
method.description: Returns the pending full-rate radius of variable rate shading. See [member XRSettings.vrs_min_radius].

method.name: get_vrs_strength
method.description: Returns the pending falloff strength of variable rate shading. See [member XRSettings.vrs_strength].

method.name: is_foveation_dynamic
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if dynamic foveation is pending. See [member XRSettings.foveation_dynamic].

method.name: is_foveation_with_subsampled_images
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if foveation with subsampled images is pending. See [member XRSettings.foveation_with_subsampled_images].

method.name: is_hand_tracking_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player wants hand tracking (game-side value). See [member XRSettings.hand_tracking_enabled].

method.name: is_interface_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the OpenXR interface exists and is initialized. Only then [method get_unsupported_setting_names] and [method get_available_display_refresh_rates] know the runtime.

method.name: is_session_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between the [signal OpenXRInterface.session_begun] and [signal OpenXRInterface.session_stopping] signals of the interface.

method.name: set_cpu_level
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.cpu_level] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_display_refresh_rate
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.display_refresh_rate] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_foveation_dynamic
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.foveation_dynamic] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_foveation_level
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.foveation_level] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_foveation_with_subsampled_images
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.foveation_with_subsampled_images] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_gpu_level
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.gpu_level] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_hand_tracking_enabled
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.hand_tracking_enabled] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_interface_override
method.description: Drives [param interface] instead of the [OpenXRInterface] of [XRServer], for example a test double or an interface of an extension with the same properties, methods and signals ([code]is_initialized[/code], [code]session_begun[/code], ...). Pushes the stored values to it. [code]null[/code] is the same as [method clear_interface_override].

method.name: set_left_hand_motion_range
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.left_hand_motion_range] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_render_target_size_multiplier
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.render_target_size_multiplier] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_right_hand_motion_range
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.right_hand_motion_range] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_vrs_min_radius
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.vrs_min_radius] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

method.name: set_vrs_strength
method.description: Sets [member XRSettings.vrs_strength] (validated; applied at once in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE], or by [method SettingsServer.apply]).

signal.name: cpu_level_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member XRSettings.cpu_level] was applied: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Also emitted while the value waits for the OpenXR interface ([method get_deferred_setting_names]) or the runtime does not support it ([method get_unsupported_setting_names]). Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: display_refresh_rate_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member XRSettings.display_refresh_rate] was applied: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Also emitted while the value waits for the OpenXR interface ([method get_deferred_setting_names]) or the runtime does not support it ([method get_unsupported_setting_names]). Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to adapt the physics tick rate to the refresh rate.
